Vegan Food in Turkey

By Richard Prouse · Not yet checked on the ground · Updated 2026-11-17

Draft. This guide has not yet been checked on the ground. It is hidden from search engines until it is.

Turkey (Türkiye) has a whole family of olive-oil vegetable dishes (zeytinyağlılar), traditionally served cold and made without meat. Lentil soup, stuffed vine leaves and the modern meat-free çiğ köfte are widely available. Butter and yogurt are the main things to ask about.

How easyMedium
Word for veganvegan
Try firstZeytinyağlı dishes from a lokanta counter

Traditional dishes in Turkey that are vegan or can be

  • Olive-oil vegetable dishes

    Zeytinyağlılar

    Vegan by tradition

    Green beans, leeks or artichokes cooked in olive oil and served cold.

  • Stuffed vine leaves

    Yalancı dolma / zeytinyağlı yaprak sarma

    Vegan by tradition

    The olive-oil version is rice-filled; the etli version contains meat.

  • Aubergine with tomato and onion

    İmam bayıldı

    Vegan by tradition

    Classic olive-oil aubergine dish.

  • Bulgur köfte

    Çiğ köfte

    Usually vegan: check

    Commercial versions are now made without meat.

  • Red lentil soup

    Mercimek çorbası

    Ask for it vegan

    Ask whether it uses butter or meat stock.

  • Sesame bread ring

    Simit

    Usually vegan: check

    Usually flour, water, yeast, molasses and sesame.

What to watch for in Turkey

  • Butter (tereyağı) poured over soups and rice
  • Yogurt (yoğurt) served on top
  • Meat stock in rice (pilav)
  • Minced meat in stuffed vegetables (etli dolma)

How to ask for vegan food in Turkish

Show this to your server, or print it:

Veganım. Et, balık, yumurta, süt ürünleri ve bal yemiyorum. Tereyağı veya yoğurt var mı?

Why Turkey (also known as Türkiye)

Turkey is the number 5 most-visited country in the world, with 57.8 million international arrivals in 2024 (UN Tourism).
